paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two logical synthesis modules, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, on the BIRD-dev dataset. The horizontal axis displays the four categories in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents execution accuracy on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. Each category contains two adjacent bars: a light blue bar for NatSQL and a dark blue bar for TA-SQL, as indicated in the legend located at the top center of the chart. For the Simple category, NatSQL achieves an accuracy of 60.21, while TA-SQL reaches 63.14. In the Moderate category, the values are 39.64 for NatSQL and 48.60 for TA-SQL. For Challenging, the accuracies are 32.32 for NatSQL and 36.11 for TA-SQL. In the Total category, NatSQL scores 51.35 and TA-SQL scores 56.19. The bars are arranged in groups for each category, with TA-SQL consistently outperforming NatSQL in all categories, as indicated by the taller dark blue bars. The chart does not include error bars or statistical significance indicators, and all values are explicitly labeled above their respective bars.
